content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are shortlisted on merit and according to the needs of the project. Meeting the minimum qualification does not guarantee an interview call. Shortlisted candidates will be told the date of the interview. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview. If you need to stay in Dhanbad, you must arrange your own accommodation.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: This is a project position, not a regular post. It lasts for a maximum of 06 months or until 28 February 2027.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Put the documents listed below into one PDF file. Make sure the file is smaller than 2 MB. Email it to Dr. Santosh Kumar Behera at [email protected] . Use this subject line: "Application for the position of Project Associate-I". Send the email by 6 November 2026. Documents to include in the PDF: A detailed CV Educational qualification documents Proof of date of birth Category certificate Relevant experience letter

faq.question: Q1. Which degree do I need for the IIT (ISM) Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: You need a B.E or B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering. It is listed as both the essential and the desirable qualification.

faq.question: Q2. Who gets Rs. 31,000 and who gets Rs. 25,000?
faq.answer: Candidates who qualified through CSIR-UGC NET (including lectureship), GATE or a national-level examination run by a Central Government department or its agencies get Rs. 31,000 plus HRA. Everyone else gets Rs. 25,000 plus HRA.

faq.question: Q3. What will the Project Associate-I do?
faq.answer: The work is preparing the 2D drawings and the 3D model of the backfilling plant for the CIL (CMPDI) paste backfilling project.

faq.question: Q4. How long will the job last?
faq.answer: It lasts for a maximum of 06 months or until 28 February 2027.

faq.question: Q5. What should I write in the email subject line?
faq.answer: Write "Application for the position of Project Associate-I" and send the email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. How big can the attachment be?
faq.answer: Send all your documents as one PDF file of less than 2 MB.

faq.question: Q7. Will everyone who meets the qualification be called for the interview?
faq.answer: No. Candidates are shortlisted on merit and according to the project's needs. Only those shortlisted will be told the interview date.

faq.question: Q8. Will IIT (ISM) pay travel costs for the interview?
faq.answer: No. No TA/DA is paid, and candidates must arrange their own stay in Dhanbad if they need one.

faq.question: Q9. Who is the Principal Investigator of the project?
faq.answer: Dr. Santosh Kumar Behera is the Principal Investigator of project SRDP 1306 I.
